يفتقر (form VIII)
# يَفْتَقِرُ (yaftaqiru) /jaf.ta.qi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَقَرَ (iftaqara)
# يُفْتَقَرُ (yuftaqaru) /juf.ta.qa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَقَرَ (iftaqara)
# يَفْتَقِرَ (yaftaqira) /jaf.ta.qi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَقَرَ (iftaqara)
